dates.name: Dancing with the Stars: LIVE! 2026 Tour
dates.desc: Live stage show featuring the magic of Dancing with the Stars with special guest co-host Andy Richter. Stunning choreography, glamorous costumes, and performances from the hit TV show. Perfect for a fun, energetic Saturday evening of dance and entertainment.

dates.name: The Temptations & The Four Tops — Motown Legends Concert
dates.desc: Iconic Motown legends performing their greatest hits live! The Temptations and Four Tops defined a generation with soulful harmonies and electrifying performances. Perfect for a fun, uplifting Sunday evening of classic music and unforgettable nostalgia.
dates.where: The Grand Theatre — Salt Lake City, UT (check website for address)

dates.name: Third Annual Craft Lake City Makers Mart
dates.desc: Celebrate local artistry! Browse and support Utah's vibrant creative community with handmade goods, art, crafts, and unique finds. Live music, local food vendors, and artistic energy. Perfect afternoon for discovering unique items and supporting artists together.

dates.name: Utah Utes Baseball — vs. Utah Valley
dates.desc: Spring college baseball under the lights! Relaxed, fun atmosphere perfect for conversation between innings. Excellent ballpark food, easy parking, and beautiful evening weather. Great casual date night with competitive college sports.

dates.name: Monster Energy AMA Supercross Championship — Salt Lake City
dates.desc: Thrilling motocross racing—the ultimate adrenaline rush! High-speed action, incredible stunts, and electric crowd energy. Similar intensity to the hockey games you love. Qualifying and FanFest start at 10 AM; main event at 5 PM. Loud, exciting, unforgettable.
dates.duration: 4 - 5 hrs (full day) or 2 - 2.5 hrs (main event only)
dates.where: Rice-Eccles Stadium — 451 S 1400 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Utah Opera — La Traviata (Running through May 17)
dates.desc: Classic opera masterpiece bringing passionate romance and drama to life. Beautiful sets, live orchestra, and world-class vocals. Perfect for arts lovers. The opera runs through May 17, so you can catch it on your preferred date during this window.
dates.where: Janet Quinney Lawson Capitol Theatre — 50 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Utes Baseball — vs. Utah Tech
dates.desc: Midweek college baseball! Perfect Tuesday evening outing with good parking, short lines, and relaxed atmosphere. Grab dinner at the ballpark and enjoy the beautiful spring weather.
dates.where: America First Ballpark — 1300 S 1300 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84104

dates.name: Real Salt Lake vs. Houston Dynamo — MLS Soccer
dates.desc: High-energy professional soccer! RSL brings competitive MLS action with passionate fans and electrifying atmosphere. Perfect for sports lovers. Beautiful spring evening at the stadium with great views and exciting playoff-caliber matches.
dates.where: Rio Tinto Stadium — 1313 S West Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84104

dates.name: Kilby Block Party 2026 — 27th Anniversary Music Festival
dates.desc: Epic music festival featuring 70+ artists across 3 days! Lorde, The xx, Turnstile, Hayley Williams, Father John Misty, Japanese Breakfast, Modest Mouse, and more. May 15 lineup (Friday) is stellar. Outdoor stages, food vendors, and vibrant festival energy. This is a can't-miss event for music lovers!
dates.start: 11:00 AM gates open, performances all day
dates.duration: Full day (6+ hours) or pick your favorite artists
dates.where: Utah State Fairpark — Salt Lake City, UT

dates.name: Utah Utes Baseball — vs. Baylor (Big 12 Conference)
dates.desc: Important Big 12 conference matchup! Competitive college baseball with playoff-caliber intensity. Multiple games over the weekend (May 14-16). Catch one or all three games if you're really into baseball.
dates.where: America First Ballpark — 1300 S 1300 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84104

dates.name: Ballet West Spring Performances — Capitol Theatre
dates.desc: Stunning ballet performances by Utah's premier ballet company. Beautiful choreography, classical elegance, and world-class dancers. Perfect for a romantic, culturally enriching evening. Running May 13-16 at Capitol Theatre.
dates.where: Janet Quinney Lawson Capitol Theatre — 50 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Garden Bros Nuclear Circus — America's Favorite Family Circus
dates.desc: World-class circus spectacle! Human Cannonball, Wheel of Death, Motorcycles in the Sphere of Fear, Human Slingshot, Chinese Acrobats, clowns, and comedy. Modern, climate-controlled Big Top with non-stop action and 60+ international performers. Fulfill your circus wishlist!
dates.start: Multiple showtimes daily: 4:30 PM & 7:30 PM (weekdays), 1:30/4:30/7:30 PM (Sat), 1/4/7 PM (Sun)
dates.where: Utah State Fairpark — Salt Lake City, UT
dates.reservation: recommended (buy in advance for best prices)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Bison, Wildflowers & Sunset Drive
dates.desc: May is peak wildflower season at Antelope Island! Drive the scenic 7-mile loop to spot native bison herds, pronghorn, and bighorn sheep against Great Salt Lake backdrops. Stunning spring wildflowers and sunset views. Perfect for your love of lake/exploration dates. Note: May has gnats, so bring insect repellent and wear protective clothing.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075 (40 min north)

dates.name: Bridal Veil Falls — Short, Easy Waterfall Hike
dates.desc: Quick, accessible 0.8-mile hike to a stunning 607-foot waterfall in Provo Canyon. Perfect spring water flow without the long commitment. Beautiful photo ops and refreshing mist. Great for exploring without the heavy time investment.
dates.where: Bridal Veil Falls Trailhead — Provo Canyon, UT (45 min from SLC)

dates.name: Snowbird Aerial Tram & Hidden Peak Sunset
dates.desc: Ride the 2,000-foot tram to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) for 360-degree views of Wasatch Mountains. Stop at the summit restaurant for sunset drinks or dinner with breathtaking alpine views. Accessible, romantic, and unforgettable.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — 9385 E Snowbird Tram Rd, Snowbird, UT 84092 (45 min east)

dates.name: Kayaking or SUP at Bear Lake — Pristine Alpine Water
dates.desc: Crystal-clear turquoise alpine lake surrounded by mountains. Peaceful paddle routes perfect for your love of lake dates. Rent kayaks or try paddleboarding. Morning calm, golden hour romance, or sunset beauty.
dates.where: Bear Lake State Park — Garden City, UT (1.5 hrs north)

dates.name: Red Butte Garden & Arboretum — Spring Botanical Walk
dates.desc: Peaceful stroll through Utah's premier botanical gardens. May features spring wildflowers, blooming trees, and lush landscapes. Pair with the Natural History Museum (nearby) or solo for a romantic, relaxing afternoon.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City Farm-to-Table
dates.desc: Intimate, chef-driven restaurant with Dave Jones' celebrated seasonal small plates. Think sweet chili-glazed cauliflower, fresh fish, heritage meats. Excellent wine list and cozy atmosphere. Sophisticated yet approachable.
dates.where: Handle — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon
dates.desc: Scenic mountain location four miles up Millcreek Canyon. Chef Dave Jones' Southwestern-influenced menu with beautiful views and excellent service. Romantic, upscale, and just minutes from downtown.
dates.where: Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon, Salt Lake City, UT 84124

dates.name: Dinner at Courchevel Bistro — French Elegance in Park City
dates.desc: Authentic French bistro with signature baked brie, venison loin, classic steak frites. Romantic ambiance, excellent service, wine pairings. Perfect Park City date night.
dates.where: Courchevel Bistro — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Rouser at Asher Adams — Downtown SLC
dates.desc: Contemporary American cuisine with fresh, seasonal ingredients. Chef-curated tasting menus available. Sophisticated urban vibe in downtown SLC. Excellent cocktails and wine selection.
dates.where: Rouser at Asher Adams — Downtown Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Dinner at APEX — Montage Deer Valley Resort
dates.desc: Elegant fine dining with sweeping mountain views. Exceptional steaks, fresh seafood, impeccable service. Expert wine pairings. Luxurious, romantic, unforgettable.
dates.where: APEX at Montage Deer Valley — Park City, UT (30 min)

dates.name: Horseback Riding at Sundance — Mountain Trail Rides
dates.desc: Guided horseback rides through Sundance's scenic mountain trails with spring wildflowers and stunning overlooks. Beginner-friendly with experienced guides. Romantic, peaceful, and unforgettable alpine experience.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604 (45 min south)

dates.name: TopGolf at Vineyard — Gamified Golf & Dinner
dates.desc: Friendly competition in private bays with automatic scoring, full bar, and great food. Zero golf skill required—just fun, laughter, and playful competition. Relaxed, upbeat date night energy.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT 84059 (30 min south)

dates.name: Escape Room Challenge — Immersive Puzzle Games
dates.desc: 60-minute immersive puzzle experience. Choose themed rooms (Egyptian Tomb, Heist, Zombie, etc). Solve puzzles together, race the clock. Great teamwork and problem-solving fun.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Symphony — Classical Masterworks & Film Scores
dates.desc: World-class orchestra performing classical music and film scores. Romantic, sophisticated, culturally enriching. Perfect for arts lovers like you. Check schedule for current spring offerings.
dates.where: Abravanel Hall — 123 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Natural History Museum of Utah — Paleontology & Exhibits
dates.desc: World-class museum with 60,000+ bones/fossils, interactive exhibits, stunning valley views. Educational and fascinating. Pair with nearby Red Butte Garden for a full afternoon of discovery.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Salt Lake City Art District Gallery Walk
dates.desc: Explore downtown SLC's vibrant arts district. Local artists, contemporary installations, rotating exhibits. Grab coffee, discuss art together, discover new favorites.
dates.where: Salt Lake City Arts District — Downtown SLC

dates.desc: Browse and support local artists and makers. Handmade goods, art, crafts, unique finds. Live music, food vendors, vibrant creative energy. Perfect for discovering unique items and supporting Utah's creative community.
